questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Meenakshi sweeps the ball excellently when she ______ an off - spin delivery.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"gets."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first part of the sentence is in the present tense, so to maintain uniformity, we have to write the V1 form of the verb **"get."**
 
• Structure for Simple Present Tense: **Subject + V1 (s/es) + Object**
 
 
• **Example:** *She plays with me.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct verb form to use is **"gets."**
 
• The correct answer **"gets" **indicates that Meenakshi currently has the ability to sweep the ball well when faced with an off-spin delivery.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence:** *Meenakshi sweeps the ball excellently when she **gets**__ an off - spin delivery.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Will get" **implies a future action, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **"Has got" **is incorrect because the past participle "got" is unnecessary in this sentence.
 
• **"Got"** is past tense and does not match the present tense of the sentence.

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The new building was being constructed by the construction workers.

options.text: The construction workers were constructing the new building.
The construction workers had been constructing the new building.
The new building has being constructed by the construction workers?
The new building is being constructed by the construction workers.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "The construction workers were constructing the new building."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Past Continuous Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + was/were + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha was singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)​​
 
 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Construction workers'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'new building.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Was being constructed' will be changed into 'were constructing'. 
 
• "Construction workers" is a plural subject so we must "were" with it.
 
• The correct option 1 follows all the above rules and correctly expresses the given sentence in active voice.

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He used to commit one theft a year on average. The stolen money lasted for the year.

B. He chose the house at Shotover Grange to commit his next burglary. He studied the design of the house carefully for a fortnight.

C. He found that the family had gone to London and the servants to the movie. He broke into the house one afternoon.

D. He hoped to get fifteen thousand pounds worth of jewels from the safe.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1) **i.e.** "ABCD."****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence A** introduces the character's annual theft habit.
 
• **Sentence B** details the planning for the next theft.
 
• **Sentence C** describes the act of burglary.
 
• **Sentence D** reveals the objective of the theft.

The correct answer is "A-B-C-D."

Complete passage: ***He used to commit one theft a year on average. The stolen money lasted for the year. He chose the house at Shotover Grange to commit his next burglary. He studied the design of the house carefully for a fortnight. He found that the family had gone to London and the servants to the movie. He broke into the house one afternoon. He hoped to get fifteen thousand pounds worth of jewels from the safe.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Chronic infections such as typhoid, chickenpox and others, for example, are no longer feared.

B. A factor contributing to the rapid rise of the population in recent years has been the drop in the death rate.

C. Because of medical breakthroughs, the death rate has decreased.

D. In 2001, the death rate in India was approximately 8.5 per thousand people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **1) BDCA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **B** is the introductory sentence that introduces the topic of the paragraph, which is the drop in the death rate.
 
• **D** provides additional information about the drop in the death rate, stating that it was approximately 8.5 per thousand people in India in 2001.
 
• **C** explains the reason for the drop in the death rate, which is medical breakthroughs.
 
• **A** is the concluding sentence that summarizes the main point of the paragraph, which is that chronic infections are no longer feared due to the drop in the death rate.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'BDCA'.**

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph**.**

A. There are 1.52 billion Aadhaar cards given to the whole population as of February 2019.

B. A financial inclusion programme called the Prime Minister's Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) makes services like banking, remittance, and insurance accessible to every Indian at a reasonable price.

C. Under the acronym JAM-Jan Dhan Yojana for Financial Inclusion, Aadhaar Biometric Identification, and Mobile Telecommunications-India is on the verge of a social revolution.

D. Beneficiaries may open an account with no balance.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph's objective is to present India's transformative approach to financial inclusion through the JAM trinity and PMJDY.
 
• **Sentence C is the first sentence** as it introduces the overarching initiative and its components:
 
 
• "Under the acronym JAM-Jan Dhan Yojana for Financial Inclusion, Aadhaar Biometric Identification, and Mobile Telecommunications-India is on the verge of a social revolution."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A follows** as it provides a fact about Aadhaar, one of the components of JAM:
 
 
• "There are 1.52 billion Aadhaar cards given to the whole population as of February 2019."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B is the third sentence** because it explains the PMJDY initiative in the context of JAM:
 
 
• "A financial inclusion programme called the Prime Minister's Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) makes services like banking, remittance, and insurance accessible to every Indian at a reasonable price."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D is the fourth** as it specifies a key feature of PMJDY:
 
 
• "Beneficiaries may open an account with no balance."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **CABD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Under the acronym JAM-Jan Dhan Yojana for Financial Inclusion, Aadhaar Biometric Identification, and Mobile Telecommunications-India is on the verge of a social revolution. There are 1.52 billion Aadhaar cards given to the whole population as of February 2019. A financial inclusion programme called the Prime Minister's Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) makes services like banking, remittance, and insurance accessible to every Indian at a reasonable price. Beneficiaries may open an account with no balance."

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Swarms have wreaked havoc on crops and caused famines and mass migrations.

B. Since prehistoric times, locusts have caused plagues.

C. Traditional methods of control rely on the use of pesticides from the ground or the air, although biological control approaches are also making great strides.

D. Changes in agricultural practices and improved observation of areas where swarms tend to form have lately allowed control measures to be implemented at an earlier stage.
questions.solution:
The **correct answer** is **option 2) BADC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Rearranging the sentences gives us:

 
• **B.** Since prehistoric times, locusts have caused plagues. 
 
• **A.** Swarms have wreaked havoc on crops and caused famines and mass migrations. 
 
• **D. **Changes in agricultural practices and improved observation of areas where swarms tend to form have lately allowed control measures to be implemented at an earlier stage. 
 
• **C**. Traditional methods of control rely on the use of pesticides from the ground or the air, although biological control approaches are also making great strides.
 
• In this order, the paragraph evolves logically from the historical problems caused by locusts (B and A) to the modern solutions and strategies for controlling them (D and C).

Therefore, the **correct answer **is** 'BADC'.**
